value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Whittier/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: SolarAPP+ account and City of Whittier online portal account
Active City of Whittier business license (required before submitting for a SolarAPP+ permit; inspections cannot be scheduled without one)
Approved SolarAPP+ documents and specifications sheet
LACFD Expedited PV/ESS Permitting Process - Inspection Checklist (completed)

value: First inspection is conducted by the LA County Fire Department (LACFD) at the nearest LACFD regional inspection office; must be completed and approved before proceeding
Then request a Building Inspection through the Building Division's online inspection portal
Have all approved paperwork, the permit, and the City of Whittier job card printed and present on site for the inspector

value.notes: The City's own SolarAPP+ page states 'Only projects that conform to this list are eligible to use the automated SolarAPP+ portal for instant permitting,' and that once fees are paid, 'your permit and City of Whittier job card will be immediately issued, electronically.'

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (licensed contractors only) / regular solar permit with plan check (owner-builders and non-eligible projects)
other_conditions: Not eligible for SolarAPP+: main panel upgrades, or systems over 38.4kW
Non-licensed/owner-builders must apply for a regular solar permit with plan check rather than SolarAPP+

Fire department setback requirements apply: modules 3 feet from exterior bearing walls, on gabled ends 18 inches from ridge and 18 inches on either side of a valley; AC disconnect must be a knife-switch style within 6 feet of the main service panel and within sight
